_method: Every file in 00-source-docs/06-addenda/ opened. Each reissued sheet was read and OVERLAID against its base-bid counterpart to diff what changed (PM-prescribed method, 07.31.26). Revision clouds, delta triangles and title-block revision entries were used to locate changes.
_authority_note: Addenda and clarifications supersede everything they touch. Index the revised sheet, never the base-bid sheet. Every drawing citation must name the revision actually read.

_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.finding: Addendum #1's own change list (section 5.01) names only FIVE reissued sheets: C1, GD, G0-00, LS1-10, A1-20. The revised-sheet PDFs actually contain SEVEN. A2-10 and A10-30 were reissued WITHOUT being announced in the addendum narrative.
_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.why_it_matters: A bidder reading the addendum text would never learn that A2-10 and A10-30 changed. Both carry real scope changes (see below). This is a probable source of bid-scope variance between subcontractors and a likely future change-order argument.
_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.pm_action: Confirm with KNIT whether A2-10 and A10-30 were intentionally reissued. If yes, the addendum's change list is defective and bidders were not properly noticed.
_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.detection_note: Reading the addendum's own table of contents would have MISSED these two sheets. Only listing the folder, opening the revised-sheet PDFs, and overlaying against the base set catches them.
